comment: Placeholders only: *.example.json files are never loaded as live routes. The chat relay route: one post per envelope in a shared channel, through your chat outbound helper (Slack, Discord, or any provider that reports sender IDs). Copy to routes.d/relay.json with a real channel and helper, and add relay-coord LAST in the target host's routes list (chat is the fallback; the owner reads it).

relay-coord.comment: sender_id is the bot user this host posts as. post_argv posts one post from {text_file}; list_argv lists channel/thread posts so receipts in the thread can be read back. Bodies are visible to every channel member; --private messages never take this route.
